name: find_patient
description: Verify a caller who says they are an existing patient. Matches on last name and date of birth. Returns their id, provider and upcoming appointments, or a no-match message.

last_name.description: Last name as said or spelled by the caller

name: register_new_patient
description: Start a record for a caller who is new to the clinic. Returns a patient id to book with.

phone.description: Mobile number for the confirmation text

name: find_openings
description: Find up to three open slots for a verified or newly registered patient, earliest first.

name: book_appointment
description: Book a slot from find_openings. Only after the caller confirmed the read-back.

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Move a booked appointment to a new slot from find_openings. Only after the caller confirmed the read-back.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel a booked appointment. Only after the caller confirmed the read-back.

name: send_confirmation_text
description: Text the patient a confirmation of a booking, change or cancellation.

phone.description: Only if the caller gave a different mobile number

name: transfer_to_staff
description: Hand the call to a person with a one-line summary. Use reason crisis for any risk of harm.
